facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Collaboration Proposal
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We are a small Instagram content studio dedicated to crafting compelling visual narratives for brands. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with you and Stumptown Coffee Roasters, designed to highlight the importance of your Direct Trade relationships. You’ve mentioned that honoring these relationships, paying quality premiums, and creating multi-year commitments are key to your mission, and we believe a shared visual experience would powerfully underscore this. The post could showcase a curated selection of your coffee beans and the unique experiences offered at Stumptown cafes, encouraging viewers to deepen their connection with the brand.  Together, we could create a visually engaging post that reinforces the value of your dedication to the Direct Trade model.

The BrandPilot team
